notes: Inbound SMB lead — very hands-on founder-led product team.
Primary ask: lightweight in-app assistant for workflow automation + contextual help (doc search + short-shot answers).
Customer quote on call: 'We want Llama-quality responses but with Mistral-like price — what's realistic?',
Trial usage so far: 12k tokens across 3 days, mostly chat-like prompts (summarization + instructions).
SE observed: Mistral-7B produced crisp short answers but struggled on long-context consistency; Llama-2 variants are higher cost in hosted tiers.
They are cost-sensitive: target <$0.002 per generated token average for steady-state usage (small scale).
Deployment: public cloud only (AWS us-west-2 preferred), no VPC/private deployment planned at this stage.
Security: Okta SSO required for admin portal; SOC2 compliance must be documented before procurement.
Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization later if numbers look good.
Mentioned competitors they trialed: OpenAI (GPT-3.5/4), Cohere for embeddings; liked cost of Mistral but curious about hallucination risk.
use_case_and_requirements: Workload type: chat-first assistant with occasional embeddings for context retrieval.
Throughput: low-medium (peaks ~20 concurrent sessions during product demos).
Latency SLO: interactive target ~200-500ms median for single-turn responses; willing to accept 800ms p95 for cost savings.
Model preferences: evaluating Llama-2-chat variants, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen-7B-Chat; open to smaller quantized variants for steady-state.
Quality vs Cost tradeoff: want to define two tiers — high-quality (larger Llama variant) for complex queries, cost-tier (Mistral/Qwen quantized) for simple replies.
Routing/fallback: interested in policy-based routing by prompt complexity and token budget; wants automatic fallback to cheaper model when cost budget exceeded.
Security/compliance needs: SSO (Okta), audit logs for admin actions, SOC2 attestation summary before contract.
model_preferences: Curious about Mistral-7B-Instruct for cost-sensitive short-answer tasks.
Asking about Llama-2-chat-xl for few-shot longer-context flows (higher token cost).
Evaluating Qwen-7B-Chat as middle ground — questions about streaming and code formatting behavior.
Quantized 4-bit variants considered to reduce per-token cost but need guidance on quality impact.
latency_throughput_targets: Median latency target: 200-500ms for chat responses.
p95 acceptable up to 800ms if it reduces cost per token materially.
Concurrent sessions: up to 20 peak, baseline 2-5 concurrent users.
cost_sensitivity: high — SMB budget, expects clear pricing tiers and a simple calculator to estimate monthly spend
